exposure: Frozen embryo transfer (FET) protocol type (programmed FET, modified natural cycle FET, true natural cycle FET)
cohort: 1,136 women who had singleton deliveries after frozen embryo transfer (FET) following assisted reproductive technology in Denmark between 2006 and 2014
finding: Programmed FET cycles were associated with a higher risk of hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, postpartum hemorrhage, cesarean section, and babies with a birth weight over 4,500g compared to natural cycle FET (modified or true).
mod_finding: Programmed FET cycles were associated with a higher risk of cesarean section compared to natural cycle FET.
